description: Oath and warstaff - a two-handed tank who turns Intellect into dodge.
_source_note: Rebuilt 5 Nov 2026 from the 39 real CoA Oathkeeper talents (role Tank). GRACEFUL FIGHTER PORTS WHOLE and is the most unusual conversion in the audit: parry from 20% of Agility AND dodge from 20% of Intellect are both legal pairs, so a tank gearing Intellect for dodge is real exactly as CoA wrote it. OATHKEEPER ITSELF cannot be built - 'damage taken is delayed and dealt over 8 seconds' needs an accumulator that does not exist, the same wall as the Witch Doctor's Puppeteer's Threads - and three talents read it. Staffguard uses absorb_pct_max_health, a payload field for a shield sized off maximum health.

nodes.name: Graceful Fighter
nodes.description: Increases your parry chance by 20% of your Agility and your dodge chance by 20% of your Intellect.
nodes._source: CoA's level 20 passive, verbatim: 'Increases your parry rating by 20% of Agility and your dodge rating by 20% of Intellect.' PORTS WHOLE, and it is the most unusual conversion node in this audit: parry AND dodge are both in STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS, and agility and intellect are both in STAT_CONVERSION_SOURCES, so CoA's cross-pairing works exactly as written. A tank that gears Intellect for dodge is a real build here. Both are FRACTIONS. Note dodge then passes through _diminish() while parry does not, so the Intellect half is worth slightly less per point.

nodes.name: Paragon
nodes.description: Increases your Stamina by 10% and your Agility by 10%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases your Stamina by 10, plus an additional amount equal to 10% of your Agility.' A FLAT 10 Stamina is meaningless at level 60 scale, and stamina_from_agility_pct is NOT a legal conversion - stamina is not in STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS, which cost Witch Hunter's Black Knight the same half earlier in this audit. Built as percentage Stamina plus the Agility that Graceful Fighter above converts into parry. Both keys take percentage POINTS.

nodes.name: Bells of Light
nodes.description: Increases your Agility, Intellect and chance to hit by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases your Agility, Intellect, and hit chance by 3%.' Doubled for the two ranks. All three port, and both stats feed Graceful Fighter - Agility into parry, Intellect into dodge - which is why a Templar tank wants a caster stat at all. agility_pct and intellect_pct take POINTS; hit_rating is a PERCENT.

nodes.name: Sacred Oath
nodes.description: Reduces the physical damage you take by 8%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Critical strikes now remove 1 sec from the duration of Oathkeeper when used. Oathkeeper: 40% of damage taken is now delayed and dealt to you over 8 seconds.' OATHKEEPER CANNOT BE BUILT: nothing defers incoming damage - take_damage applies it immediately and there is no accumulator to hold a deferred pool - so there is no duration to shorten either. This is the same wall that took the Witch Doctor's Puppeteer's Threads and Brewing's Base: Beast Blood, which is the identical 'damage taken becomes damage over time' idea. Re-pointed at straight physical mitigation, which is what delaying 40% of a hit buys a tank. AS A TALENT EFFECT physical_damage_taken_pct is a FRACTION where NEGATIVE reduces.

nodes.name: Grace of Aman'thul
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of Righteous Lunge and Sacred Swing by 20%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Reduces the Energy cost of Righteous Lunge by -5 and Sacred Swing by -10.' CoA's Templar spends Energy; Frontier's spends COMBO, a real primary pool with six generators (see the Zealot builder), so there is a genuine cost to cut. The two different flat amounts become one percentage, since costs differ per rank anyway. POSITIVE reduces.

nodes.name: Staffguard
nodes.description: Sacred Swing raises a guard, absorbing damage equal to 8% of your maximum health for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Casting Sacred Swing now grants you Staffguard, absorbing damage, scaling with Stamina, parry and dodge rating, for 8 sec.' USES absorb_pct_max_health, a payload field most of this audit has not needed: an apply_effect can carry a shield sized as a percentage of the recipient's maximum health (status_effects.py:1479). That is the one honest way to build 'absorbs, scaling with Stamina' - a payload cannot read a stat, but maximum health already carries Stamina, so the scaling is real rather than faked. 8 sec is 3 turns.

nodes.name: Sacred Resistance
nodes.description: Reckoning hardens you, raising your armour by 15% for 5 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Casting Reckoning now increases your Armor by 15% for 15 seconds.' PORTS EXACTLY - CoA's 15%, and 15 sec is 5 turns. armor_pct takes percentage POINTS inside a status effect as well as on a talent, so 15.0 is right on both sides.

nodes.name: Conviction
nodes.description: Sacred Swing quickens you, raising your haste by 5% per stack for 5 turns, stacking 4 times.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Casting Sacred Swing now increases your melee haste by 5% for 15 seconds, stacking 4 times.' PORTS EXACTLY - CoA's 5% and 4 stacks, 15 sec as 5 turns. One of the cleanest nodes in the tree because it asks for nothing the engine lacks.

nodes.name: Holy Warstaff
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Reckoning by 20%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the damage of Reckoning by 20%.' Ports exactly. CoA gates Reckoning on two-handed weapons; requires_weapon does not exist as a talent condition, so the weapon requirement lives on the ability or not at all - the same limit that made Guardian Gladiator's four Training nodes unconditional.

nodes.name: Parry Dance
nodes.description: Parrying an attack raises your parry chance by 3% per stack for 2 turns, stacking 5 times.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'When you critically strike with auto attacks or parry an attack, your chance to parry is now increased by 3% for 5 sec, stacking 5 times.' on_parry IS a live trigger (fired from Character._fire_avoidance_procs), so the parry half ports exactly - CoA's 3% and 5 stacks, 5 sec as 2 turns. The auto-attack-crit half is dropped rather than merged: two triggers would need two procs and would double-stack on a turn where both happen.

nodes.name: Disciplined Mind
nodes.description: Increases the healing of Benediction by 30%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases the healing of Benediction by 15% and causes it to dispel 1 poison and disease effect.' Doubled for the two ranks. No key adds a dispel to an ability - dispelling is an effect_type, not a rider - so that half is dropped.

nodes.name: Justicar of the Light
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Benediction by 50%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Removes the cooldown from Benediction, but increases its Energy cost by 10.' A FULL COOLDOWN REMOVAL is expressible (1.0) but would make the tank's self-heal spammable, and NO KEY ADDS A COST - _cost_pct is positive-reduces, so CoA's downside cannot be charged in either direction. Priced at half the cooldown with no penalty, which is the honest middle.

nodes.name: Guardian of the Light
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of Temple Guardian by 50%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Casting Benediction now reduces the cost of your next Temple Guardian by -50% for 6 seconds.' Nothing discounts a named next cast, so the 50% is permanent. Temple Guardian is target_type 'party', so making it cheaper is real party value - the same reasoning as Zealot's Force of Golganneth node.

nodes.name: Way of the Monk
nodes.description: Sacred Swing and Reckoning leave the enemy dealing 10% less damage for 3 turns, stacking twice.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Damage dealt by Sacred Swing and Reckoning now reduces casting speed by 10% for 10 sec, stacking 2 times.' THERE IS NO CASTER-SIDE SPEED DEBUFF KEY - haste is attacker-side and nothing slows a target's casting - so it becomes a damage reduction, which is the mitigation a slowed caster represents to a tank. CoA's 10% and 2 stacks kept; 10 sec is 3 turns. damage_dealt_pct inside a status effect is percentage POINTS.

nodes.name: Fortified Body
nodes.description: Increases your maximum health by 6% and the healing you receive by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Allies within 40 yds receive 6% more healing. Does not stack with similar effects. Additionally, increases your maximum health by 6%.' A TALENT CANNOT REACH AN ALLY, so the healing-received half lands on the Templar too and the description says 'you'. BOTH KEYS ARE FRACTIONS AS TALENT EFFECTS - max_health_pct and healing_taken_pct each flip to percentage POINTS inside a status effect, which is exactly the pair that shipped 600% and 1000% on earlier trees before being caught.

nodes.name: Call of the Monastery
nodes.description: Increases your attack power by 10%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the attack power of all party and raid members 5%. Does not stack with similar effects. In addition, increases your attack power by 5%.' A talent cannot reach an ally, so CoA's two 5% halves land on the Templar as a single 10%. attack_power_pct takes percentage POINTS.

nodes.name: Faith Guard
nodes.description:
Increases the damage of Chastise by 30% and the threat you
generate by 20%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'While a Libram is active, your Chastise will now unleash a line of holy power, dealing High Threat Holy damage.' The 'while a Libram is active' gate has no key - nothing reads whether a buff is up - and a line is positional. Built as damage plus threat on Chastise, which is what High Threat means for a tank. threat_generation_pct is a FRACTION where POSITIVE increases, the opposite polarity to the _cost_pct keys.

nodes.name: Disciplined Blows
nodes.description: Your heals pulse holy power, striking the enemy for holy damage.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Your healing done triggers a holy pulse around healed targets, dealing Holy damage to nearby enemies. Can only occur once every 0.5 sec.' on_heal_cast with a damage_flat payload is the right shape - a tank healing itself and damaging what it is holding. The pulse lands on the current target rather than around the healed ally, since a payload has no radius. 1-turn icd covers CoA's rate limit.

nodes.name: Absolution
nodes.description: Increases the threat you generate by 30% and your armour by 10%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Taunt all enemies within 8 yds for 4 sec and increase your movement speed by 50% for 4 sec.' Frontier HAS Absolution as an ability and it is not gated, so this is not its unlock. An AoE taunt is the ability's own business and movement speed is positional, so the talent is built as the threat and survivability a taunt node should carry for a tank.

nodes.name: Holy Books
nodes.description: Reduces all damage you take by 7%.
nodes._source: CoA's level 30 passive: 'Using a Libram now removes 70% of the delayed damage from Oathkeeper.' OATHKEEPER'S DELAYED DAMAGE DOES NOT EXIST (see Sacred Oath at tier 0 - nothing defers incoming damage), so there is no pool to clear. Re-pointed at flat mitigation, which is what clearing 70% of a deferred hit amounted to. BARE damage_taken_pct IS READ RAW, so 7% is -0.07 - authoring -7.0 would be a 700% reduction, the immortality bug from Boltslinger's Evasive.

nodes.name: Duty Calls
nodes.description: Your strikes build resolve, raising your damage by 2% per stack for 5 turns, stacking 5 times.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Casting abilities that grant an Oath now increases your damage dealt and movement speed by 2% for 15 sec, stacking 5 times.' Oaths do not exist (see the Zealot builder), so it fires off the combo builders - which in CoA are the abilities that grant Oaths, so the stacks build in the same part of the rotation. Movement speed is positional. CoA's 2% and 5 stacks kept; 15 sec is 5 turns.

nodes.name: Barrier of Light
nodes.description: Increases the healing you receive by 20% and reduces the cooldown of Barrier of Light by 30%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Emit saving light, increasing the healing received by nearby party and raid members by 40% for 15 sec. For the duration, threat generated by your allies is redirected to you.' Frontier HAS Barrier of Light as a target_type 'party' ability and it is not gated, so this is not its unlock - and because the ABILITY is party-targeted, its own healing bonus does reach allies. The talent's own 20% lands on the Templar (a talent cannot reach an ally) at half CoA's figure. Threat redirection has no mechanism. AS A TALENT EFFECT healing_taken_pct is a FRACTION.

nodes.name: Sacred Swing
nodes.description:
Increases the damage of Sacred Swing by 40% and the threat you
generate by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Swing at enemies in front of you, dealing 125% High Threat Weapon Damage, slowing their attack and movement speed by 20% for 10 sec. Only usable after avoiding an attack.' Frontier HAS Sacred Swing and it is not gated. The 'only usable after avoiding an attack' condition lives on the ability, not here - no talent key gates usability - and attack speed has no key. Built as damage plus the High Threat the tooltip names.

nodes.name: Paragon of Light
nodes.description: Increases your dodge and parry chance by 4% each.
nodes._source: CoA's Parry Dance and Graceful Fighter both point at avoidance, and this node carries the flat version neither does. NOT a direct port of a single CoA talent - built from the spec's avoidance theme so tier 5 has a defensive stat node rather than a third damage line, and flagged as such. Both keys are PERCENT and both now matter MORE than they did this morning: creature avoidance went in today, which means expertise exists, which means avoidance is a two-sided stat rather than player-only.

nodes.name: Tome of Light
nodes.description: Teaches Tome of Light, and reduces all damage you take by 8%.
nodes._source: LOAD-BEARING UNLOCK: templar_tome_of_light carries requires_talent, so without this node it is unobtainable forever. Templar has exactly three gated abilities, one per tree - Zealot's Norgannon's Wrath, Crusader's Righteous Tempest and this - and main() asserts this one. The mitigation is added because a capstone granting only an ability is thin, and a tank capstone should be defensive. BARE damage_taken_pct IS READ RAW, so 8% is -0.08; it stacks with Holy Books at tier 4 for 15% on a full Oathkeeper build.
